relationships.subject: miR-135a/b
relationships.evidence_quote: overexpression of miR-135a and miR-135b suppresses HOXA10 expression, thereby impairing embryo implantation and endometrial receptivity

relationships.subject: oxidative stress
relationships.evidence_quote: OS has been linked to increased DNMT1 activity in EM, resulting in hypermethylation and silencing of key genes such as HOXA10 and PGR

relationships.subject: HDAC1/2
relationships.evidence_quote: Overexpression of histone acetyltransferases such as p300/CBP, enhancer of zeste homolog 2 (EZH2), and histone deacetylases (HDAC1/2) creates a permissive chromatin state that facilitates cellular invasion, increases inflammatory cytokine production, and promotes epithelial–mesenchymal transition

key_findings: Narrative review integrating epigenetic dysregulation, oxidative stress and microbiome dysbiosis in endometriosis.
DNA hypermethylation of HOXA10/PGR-B and overexpression of HDAC1/2 and EZH2 implicated in lesion biology.
